name: Mr. C Miami - Coconut Grove
insider_take: This sleek Coconut Grove gem brings Italian sophistication to Miami's most bohemian neighborhood, where yacht clubs meet artisan markets.
whats_special: Mr. C Miami occupies a prime waterfront location in historic Coconut Grove, Miami's oldest neighborhood founded in 1873. The hotel's Italian heritage shines through its Bellini restaurant, while guests enjoy direct access to the Grove's famous peacock population at nearby Peacock Park - a quirky legacy from the area's 1960s hippie era.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view room to watch the spectacular sunsets over Biscayne Bay, and time your visit with the monthly Coconut Grove Farmers Market for the best local artisan finds.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop pool overlooks the marina where you can spot manatees year-round. Walk to the iconic Barnacle Historic State Park, home to Miami's oldest house, or catch a movie at the charming CocoWalk outdoor shopping center - all within a 5-minute stroll.
pros: Sophisticated Italian hospitality with Cipriani family heritage
Prime Coconut Grove location with bay views
Elegant rooms with modern amenities and Italian design
Exceptional dining at Bellini restaurant and rooftop bar
cons: Intimate boutique size may limit amenities compared to larger resorts
